description: Machine-readable smoke test catalog for rekit maintainers. This file is a navigation aid, not an automatic test runner.
globalBoundaries: Use temporary cases unless a script explicitly supports a known dryrun case.
Do not point smoke tests at real case data.
Do not execute samples, network requests, scans, fuzzing, exploit replay, debug, dump, patch, hooks, device connections, or external side effects.
Do not write authority or confirmed artifacts outside scripts that explicitly validate a temporary-case gate.

tests.purpose: Validate PowerShell facade default delegation and retired fallback boundaries, including no legacy runtime load, release-check inventory, plan-subagents planning/reviewer-intake forwarding, run-current-step/run-reviewer-step forwarding, bounded run-current-loop MaxSteps/hash/first-step reviewer observation forwarding, caller-CWD-relative packet/result normalization, cross-command guards, disabled no-fallback, and lifecycle/gate JSON preview/apply/text delegation.
tests.riskBoundary: Default fixture is self-contained; explicit CaseRoot must be a known dryrun case.

tests.purpose: Validate packs/status/doctor/validate text and JSON parity across Go, PowerShell, and facade delegation.
tests.riskBoundary: Read-only except transient invalid pack fixtures that are created and removed inside packs/.
